sources.content: Mossgrade agent notes. Mossgrade runs evaluation suites against language models and writes scores to a results database. Python 3.12, managed with Poetry. Install with `poetry install` and run tests with `poetry run pytest -q`. Each suite is a folder in `suites/` holding a `suite.yaml` and a `cases.jsonl` file. Run one suite with `poetry run mossgrade run suites/<name>`. By default a run uses 8 parallel workers and a per case timeout of 90 seconds; change these with `--workers` and `--timeout`.

Rules for Mossgrade. Never edit `cases.jsonl` in a released suite; copy it into a new suite with a higher version number. Scores are floats between 0 and 1, rounded to four decimal places only at display time. Model API keys come from the file whose path is set in `MOSSGRADE_KEYS`, and they must never appear in logs or results. Add a line to `CHANGELOG.md` for any change to scoring code. Use Black with a line length of 100. Do not add network calls to scorers; scorers must be pure functions.

claims.text: A Mossgrade run uses 8 parallel workers by default.
Mossgrade scorers must be pure functions.
Mossgrade code is formatted with Black at a line length of 120.
Each Mossgrade suite folder holds a suite.yaml file.
Mossgrade scores are floats between 0 and 1.
Mossgrade manages its dependencies with Poetry.
